'''Tornak Po''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] loyal to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist cause]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the war he wasn't able to pay his debts due to the Separatists losing the war. It was rumored he either went into hiding or got trapped in his [[Yacht/Legends|luxury yacht]] in the desolate wastes of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] southern polar region with a force of [[HKB-3 hunter-killer droid|hunter-killer droids]] for his protection.<ref name="SGtD" />
